newsitem.title: USA: Ambi says cardia salt study successful.
newsitem.headline: Ambi says cardia salt study successful.

text.p: Ambi Inc said Thursday results of a study show its dietary aid called cardia salt alternative significantly reduces blood pressure in hypertensive patients who treated with antihypertensive drugs.

Data from the double-blind, placebo-controlled, multicenter clinical study will be presented at the twelfth scientific meeting of the American Society of Hypertension in San Francisco on Saturday, May 31.
The company said the study found statistically significant reductions in blood pressure of 4.15 and 2.7 millimeters of mercury respectively in the cardia group compared to the regular salt group.
